# OpenProject

> > Open-source project management software with Gantt charts, time tracking, and collaboration features, developed in Germany with enterprise cloud hosting options.

OpenProject is a comprehensive project management platform offering work package tracking, resource planning, and integrations with tools like Nextcloud and GitHub. The software emphasizes data sovereignty, GDPR compliance, and accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1.

## Key Topics

- Project management
- Work packages
- Gantt charts
- Time tracking
- OpenProject Enterprise cloud
- GDPR compliance
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1)
- Nextcloud integration
- Resource planning
- Public sector solutions
- Open-source software
- Data sovereignty
- Germany-based development
- Phase gates and project lifecycle
- High contrast mode

## Installation and Deployment

- [Installing OpenProject – with Helm Charts, packages and Docker](https://www.openproject.org/es/blog/installation-helm-charts-packages-docker): Guide to installing OpenProject with Helm Charts, Kubernetes, and Docker

## Major Releases and Features

- [OpenProject 16.1: Estructura el ciclo de vida de tu proyecto con fases y puertas de fase](https://www.openproject.org/es/blog/lanzamiento-de-openproject-16-1): OpenProject 16.1 release: project lifecycle phases and phase gates feature
- [Mi seguimiento del tiempo: estructure su jornada laboral con una vista de calendario](https://www.openproject.org/es/blog/modulo-de-seguimiento-del-tiempo): OpenProject 16.0 preview: personal time tracking module with calendar view
- [Our commitment to accessibility: High contrast mode arrives with OpenProject 13.1](https://www.openproject.org/es/blog/accessibility-high-contrast-mode): OpenProject 13.1 adds high contrast mode for WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance
- [OpenProject 8.0 release candidate offers a sneak preview for new powerful collaboration features](https://www.openproject.org/pt/blog/openproject-8-0-release-candidate): OpenProject 8.0 RC: WYSIWYG editor and enhanced collaboration features preview
- [OpenProject 7.0 released](https://www.openproject.org/es/blog/openproject-7-0-released): OpenProject 7.0 release: enhanced Gantt timeline and work package hierarchies
